public_context.description: A deliberately hypothetical agent workload constructed to stress the optimizer. The three public registered transactions in DF-PUBLIC-001 provide market context only; they do not establish these leads, mandates, commissions, probabilities, deadlines, or tasks.
public_context.boundary: All candidate actions are hypothetical. All numeric inputs are synthetic assumptions. They are not claims about a real agent, client, listing, mandate, or commission.

candidate_actions.assumption_notes: Entire rental opportunity and all numeric inputs are invented; no public observation supports this lead.
